readme: Hand-written: the router defines two elements, as classes. tests/custom-elements-manifest.test.ts holds it against the sources. category, order (after @pdxui/ui's last) and summary place them on the site, in the skills and in llms.txt.

declarations.name: PdxRouterOutlet
declarations.summary: Where the page the current route matches is rendered.
declarations.description: Renders the page the current route matches. Without a name it is the main outlet; nested outlets render the nested routes of the page around them.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: A named outlet renders the route component its route assigns to that name (`outlets`), beside the main one.

declarations.name: PdxLink
declarations.summary: A link that navigates without a reload and marks itself active.
declarations.description: A navigation link: renders an <a>, navigates without a reload, marks itself active, and fetches the target route's chunk ahead of the click.

attributes.name: to
attributes.description: The path to navigate to. A route pattern (`/users/:id`) is filled from `params`.

attributes.name: exact
attributes.description: Active only when the current path is exactly `to`, not when it starts with it.

attributes.name: active-class
attributes.description: The class added while the link's target is the current route.

attributes.name: prefetch
attributes.description: `never` turns off fetching the route's chunk on hover, focus and pointerdown; otherwise the route's own @prefetch decides.

attributes.name: params
attributes.description: JSON object of route params that fill the pattern in `to`.

members.name: to
members.description: Reflected to the `to` attribute, so a binding works.

members.name: exact
members.description: Reflected to the `exact` attribute, so a binding works.
